description: Turns one voltage into 32 gates, taken from the bits of that voltage or from a random number seeded by it

params.text: Shifts the read range to -5V to 5V in place of 0-10V
Picks how the gates are made: ieee takes the raw bits of the input as a floating point number, int spreads the input over a 32 bit whole number, rnd seeds one random number with that

inputs.text: The voltage the gates are made from, 0-10V, or -5V to 5V when BiPolar is on
With a cable patched here the gates are made on each rising edge and held between edges; with nothing patched they follow the input continuously
Selects the method, one volt per method, and overrides the method switch while patched

outputs.text: The first sixteen bits, one per channel, 10V for a set bit and 0V for a clear one
The last sixteen bits, one per channel, 10V for a set bit and 0V for a clear one
